methodology_other: Human validated results from MapSwipe app
name: mapswipe_myanmar_buildings
notes:
MapSwipe results focusing on areas with at least one building. This data is collected through the MapSwipe platform, whereby humans visually check for the presence of buildings using satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery for Myanmar). It combines results from several MapSwipe projects listed below. In the download files below the 'results_yes_maybe' are the results and the original input areas are 'aois'.

 Source MapSwipe Projects

- [Myanmar: Find - Buildings - Earthquake Response (2)](https://mapswipe.org/en/projects/-OMTfDy03ThqukWPeBVp/)
- [Myanmar: Find - Buildings - Earthquake Response (3)](https://mapswipe.org/en/projects/-OMqANF17XQSJaxob4LN/)
- [Myanmar: Find - Buildings - Earthquake Response (4)](https://mapswipe.org/en/projects/-OMunaJmhQt4kOIb2gGH/)
- [Myanmar: Find - Buildings - Earthquake Response (5)](https://mapswipe.org/en/projects/-OMutBu0Xcoqv7TNQCsl/)
- [Myanmar: Find - Buildings - Earthquake Response (6)](https://mapswipe.org/en/projects/-ONJMQSebtiitGYE3kgQ/)
- [Myanmar: Find - Buildings - Earthquake Response (7)](https://mapswipe.org/en/projects/-ONJNeX0h63Pw5jpLp7y/)
- [Myanmar: Find - Buildings - Earthquake Response (8)](https://mapswipe.org/en/projects/-ON_t1ETBDR2H4nqVxiA/)

organization.description:
**For up-to-the-minute exports from OpenStreetMap in a variety of formats for GPS and GIS, visit http://export.hotosm.org**

Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) acts as a bridge between the traditional humanitarian responders and the OpenStreetMap Community. HOT works both remotely and physically in countries to assist the collection of geographic data, usage of that information and training others in OpenStreetMap.
